# F-TSK-01 Create a task

## Story
As a member, I create a task with a title. Keys follow domain.md §Keys.

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] **F-TSK-01.AC1** Given no tasks, when a member creates "A", then it is saved with key TSK-1. `[docs]`
- [ ] **F-TSK-01.AC2** Given a member, when the title is empty, then the request fails with 400. `[docs]`

## Failure modes
- Empty title → F-TSK-01.AC2
